mechanism: Fluphenazine may inhibit levonorgestrel metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially increasing hormonal contraceptive levels and adverse effects, while levonorgestrel may induce fluphenazine metabolism, reducing antipsychotic efficacy.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding or contraceptive failure; consider alternative antipsychotic or use backup contraception; counsel on symptoms of hormonal excess and psychotic symptom breakthrough.
